newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mostly down.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids mostly down.

text.p: Dark Northern Spring Wheat bids on Wednesday were mostly lower while soft white wheat values firmed.
Movement was shut off in parts of North Dakota due to high water levels and flooding along the Red River Valley region, one North Dakota merchandiser said.
"Movement is pretty much at a standstill this week," the merchandiser said.
One dealer said he believed the only problems with delayed spring wheat plantings would also be in the Red River Valley region.

A severe weekend snow and wind storm still left about 5,000 customers without electricity in North Dakota Wednesday. Also, a blizzard that dumped 23 inches of snow on Manitoba's Red River Valley over the weekend was forecast to cause the worst flooding of the century, Winnipeg's Harbor Master said.
But in Montana, dealers cited some farm sales of hard red winter wheat.
